ai.sense: the mechanism that lets each token weigh every other token when computing what it means in context
ai.origin: Bahdanau, Cho, Bengio 2014 (attention for translation); Vaswani et al. 2017, 'Attention Is All You Need' (the Transformer)

senses.meaning: care shown to a person; being noticed
senses.phrase: all I wanted was your attention

senses.meaning: the scarce resource platforms sell to advertisers
the rigid ready posture on command
what a teacher demands of a class

anchors.name: Attention Is All You Need
anchors.what: 2017 Google paper that introduced the Transformer; its title riffs on the Beatles' 'All You Need Is Love'

anchors.name: attention economy
anchors.what: Herbert Simon 1971: 'a wealth of information creates a poverty of attention'

pivots.line: Attention is all you need, and you gave me none
I attend to every word you never said
Paying attention costs a fortune now

enact.music: every stem ducks except one: the attended voice
enact.picture: glowing lines fan from one word to the words it weighs, like a heat map of who looked at whom
enact.type: the attended word scales up while the rest of the line dims

risk: 'Attention Is All You Need' is the most used pun in AI culture; use it only twisted
notes: The love and money senses collide: the attention economy sells exactly what a lover asks for.
